notes.title: Big Update : AI Opponents
notes.notes:
The Update with the AI ​​Opponents is live.

Compete against up to 4 Computer Players.

Build your defenses with Cameras, Drones and Security Guards. Prevent the opponent from destroying your Oil Rigs.

Attack the Enemy with incendiary Devices and damage their Oil Wells. Set Fire to Derrick, Drill Factory and His Control Station to damage him.

Blow up his Derricks to drive him out of the Area.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
Complete revision of some widgets.

Load new pictures at the level.

Complete overhaul of the starting estate.

Give your company a name.

Many new assets have been added.

Console for bottling plant was renewed.

bugfixes.

What is being worked on?

Messages are coming in telling management that various pumps
no longer work and require repair. This should be tackled quickly, otherwise the production volume will fall.
